```{r setup}
library(allocatR)
```

This vignette covers use of the allocatR package to randomly assign participants
in a randomised clinical trial. It assumes that R can be connected to your trial
infrastructure through one of the following:
* R is run directly on the server containing trial data
* R is run remotely using an API call to the server containing trial data
* Randomisation is fully self-contained within e.g. a locally run Shiny app.

The specific method of integration is beyond the scope of this vignette and will
vary with your implementation. For illustrative purposes, this vignette uses code
compatible with the Research Electronic Data Capture (REDCap) API.
